# Pinterest Korea

> > A visual discovery platform connecting users with curated boards spanning educational content, fan communities, fashion inspiration, and creative DIY projects.

Pinterest Korea (kr.pinterest.com) serves as a hub for Korean and international users to discover and share visual inspiration across multiple categories including ESL education, gaming fan art, fashion trends, and crafting. The platform hosts creator profiles and thematic idea boards spanning language learning, animation content, webtoon fandoms, and style guides.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest
- ESL Materials
- English Learning
- Conversation Practice
- Discussion Questions
- Content Creator
- Limbus Company
- Korean Fashion
- DIY Clothing
- Animation
- Project Moon
- Vocabulary Graphics
- K-pop Inspiration
- Fan Art
- Language Education

## Creator Profiles

- [Print Discuss (printdiscuss) - Profile](https://kr.pinterest.com/printdiscuss/): Creator profile showcasing ESL materials, discussion resources, and English conversation practice content
- [Shappy (Shappysway) - Profile](https://kr.pinterest.com/shappysway/): Content creator profile featuring adult comedy animation and entertainment-focused unhinged content

## Gaming & Fandom

- [Limbus Company 만화](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/림버스-컴퍼니-만화/912539475083/): Ideas board dedicated to Limbus Company fan art, game character collections, and Project Moon webtoon content

## Fashion & Style

- [고라니윤](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/고라니윤/930135399918/): Ideas board for Korean fashion inspiration, ulzzang style guides, and K-pop idol fashion references

## DIY & Crafting

- [Выкройка Фуфайки Женской](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/выкройка-фуфайки-женской/914164128543/): Ideas board for women's quilted jacket sewing patterns, DIY clothing construction, and fashion design tutorials
